assessmentScope: Historical Stage A/B checkpoint only; superseded by full-coverage.json. Entries below are not current whole-app status.

features.scope: Offline Android foundation and official Material 3 navigation
knownDifferences: No login, original backend, network permission, cloud synchronization or analytics
Real API 26/36 execution and physical TalkBack service testing await C10
Theme controls are scheduled for C8; system/dynamic theme currently defaults on

features.scope: Exact money, basic postings and atomic ledger mutations
knownDifferences: Advanced transaction kinds, fees and cross-currency transfer are not enabled until C1/C2
No binary floating-point money storage

features.scope: Books, asset accounts and two-level categories
knownDifferences: Accounts are shared locally across books; categories belong to one book
Archiving a parent archives its children; restoring the parent does not silently restore children

features.scope: Manual editor, raw draft recovery and bill lifecycle
knownDifferences: Unknown transaction times require manual confirmation
List date grouping uses the selected book timezone; details retain transaction timezone
Batch operations are scheduled for C7

features.scope: Private image attachments and accessible image viewer
knownDifferences: No broad media-library permission
No claim of process death while the system picker itself was open
Orphaned private images are retained pending reference-safe cleanup

features.scope: Complete local backup, validated preview, merge and replacement
knownDifferences: Same-ID content conflicts block merge rather than silently choosing a winner
One private before-replacement recovery snapshot is retained
A chosen external document provider may synchronize files independently
CSV and original-app import compatibility await C9

features.scope: Accessibility recognition, 56 scenario rule index, draft queue, overlay, OCR and no-op AI contract

nativeChecks: force-stop and raw queue draft recovery

knownDifferences: All 56 scenarios have synthetic positive/negative fixtures; zero live third-party payment-app scenarios are verified
No generative AI provider, model download or keys; bundled OCR is the separate approved local image reader
Explicit currency conflicts leave amount unknown
Per-scenario evidence is in recognition-coverage.json
Four deferred UI minors and device limits are in acceptance-B.md

features.scope: Advanced finance, budgets, statistics, recurrence/installments, savings, CSV, settings/privacy lock and widgets
knownDifferences: Stages A and B are not the whole-project delivery
Statistics is an explicit empty destination until C5
Manufacturer-specific widgets and live exchange rates are outside the local implementation
